quotes.text: request cancellation is not currently fully implemented, only stubbed out

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 482 introduces a CancellableRequest whose Cancel logs that cancellation is stubbed and returns Ok. The same stub remains in protocol_shared at the fixed current revision; other request methods return NS_ERROR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. A successful API result is not proof that the outgoing HTTP operation was aborted. Current listener/caller orchestration changed, so this is a scoped implementation limitation, not an allegation that every cancellation path fails.
title: Do not claim that a successful stub Cancel stopped the network request
